    - [Account](/cli/account/index.html): Explore the documentation pages and resources in **Account**.
      - [Droid Shield](/cli/account/droid-shield.html): Droid Shield is a built-in security feature that automatically scans un-committed changes for potential secrets before committing and pushing them to remote. It acts as a safety net to prevent accidental exposure of sensitive credentials li
      - [Droid Shield Plus](/cli/account/droid-shield-plus.html): <Aside kind="info"> **Enterprise Feature** — Droid Shield Plus is available for enterprise customers. \[Contact us\]\(mailto:sales@factory.ai\) to enable this feature for your organization. </Aside>
      - [Security](/cli/account/security.html): The Droid CLI is built with security at its core. Your code stays secure through encrypted authentication, strict permissions, and enterprise-grade protections.
    - [Bring Your Own Key \(BYOK\)](/cli/byok/index.html): Explore the documentation pages and resources in **Bring Your Own Key \(BYOK\)**.
      - [Baseten](/cli/byok/baseten.html): Deploy and serve custom models with Baseten's enterprise-grade infrastructure for ML model serving.
      - [DeepInfra](/cli/byok/deepinfra.html): Access cost-effective inference for a wide variety of open-source models with DeepInfra's optimized infrastructure.
      - [Fireworks AI](/cli/byok/fireworks.html): Access high-performance inference for open-source models with Fireworks AI's optimized serving infrastructure.
      - [Google Gemini](/cli/byok/google-gemini.html): Connect to Google's Gemini models for advanced AI capabilities with multimodal support.
      - [Groq](/cli/byok/groq.html): Access ultra-fast inference powered by Groq's LPU™ \(Language Processing Unit\) Inference Engine for various open-source models.
      - [Hugging Face](/cli/byok/huggingface.html): Connect to thousands of models hosted on Hugging Face's Inference Providers. Learn more in the \[Inference Providers documentation\]\(https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/en/index\).
      - [LM Studio](/cli/byok/lm-studio.html): Run models locally on your hardware with LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible local server.
      - [Ollama](/cli/byok/ollama.html): Run models locally on your hardware with Ollama, or use Ollama Cloud for hosted inference.
      - [OpenAI & Anthropic](/cli/byok/openai-anthropic.html): Use your own API keys for cost control and billing transparency with official OpenAI and Anthropic models.
      - [OpenRouter](/cli/byok/openrouter.html): Connect to OpenRouter for access to models from multiple providers through a single API interface.
      - [Bring Your Own Key \(BYOK\)](/cli/byok/overview.html): The Droid CLI supports custom model configurations through BYOK \(Bring Your Own Key\). Use your own OpenAI or Anthropic keys, connect to any open source model providers, or run models locally on your hardware. Once configured, switch between
    - [CLI Configuration & Hooks](/cli/configuration/index.html): Explore the documentation pages and resources in **CLI Configuration & Hooks**.
      - [AGENTS.md](/cli/configuration/agents-md.html): **AGENTS.md** is a Markdown file that lives in your repository \(or home directory\) and acts as a _briefing packet_ for AI coding agents.
      - [Subagents](/cli/configuration/custom-droids.html): A **subagent** is a separate agent that Droid launches through the **Task** tool to handle a focused piece of work. Each subagent runs in its own context window and its own session, with its own system prompt, tool policy, model, and autono
      - [Custom Slash Commands](/cli/configuration/custom-slash-commands.html): Custom slash commands turn repeatable prompts or setup steps into `/shortcuts`. Droid scans a pair of `.factory/commands` folders, turns each file into a command, and pipes the result straight into the conversation or your terminal session.
      - [Hooks](/cli/configuration/hooks-guide.html): Droid hooks are user-defined shell commands that execute at various points in Droid's lifecycle. Hooks provide deterministic control over Droid's behavior, ensuring certain actions always happen rather than relying on Droid to choose to run
      - [Model Context Protocol \(MCP\)](/cli/configuration/mcp.html): Model Context Protocol \(MCP\) servers extend droid's capabilities by providing additional tools and context. Droid offers two ways to manage them: an interactive UI for easy browsing and setup, or CLI commands for scripting and automation.
      - [Mixed Models](/cli/configuration/mixed-models.html): Mixed models allow you to use a different AI model specifically for Specification Mode planning while keeping a separate default model for regular coding sessions. This gives you the flexibility to optimize both planning and implementation 
      - [Plugins](/cli/configuration/plugins.html): Plugins let you extend Droid with custom functionality that can be shared across projects and teams. A plugin bundles skills, slash commands, agents, and MCP servers into a single, distributable package.
      - [Sandbox](/cli/configuration/sandbox.html): <Aside kind="note"> **Beta** — OS-level Sandbox is opt-in and under active development. Behavior, settings, and platform support may change between releases. </Aside>

    - [Droid Exec \(Headless & CI/CD\)](/cli/droid-exec/index.html): Explore the documentation pages and resources in **Droid Exec \(Headless & CI/CD\)**.

      - [Factoryリリース 1.9](/jp/changelog/1-9.html): Factory 1.9では、作業の各段階に適切なモデルを選択できる混合モデル、ワークフローに合わせてカスタマイズできるカスタムサブエージェント、そして新しいGitHub Appによる自動化

        - [Ollama](/jp/cli/byok/ollama.html): Ollamaを使用してローカルハードウェアでモデルを実行するか、ホスト型推論にはOllama Cloudを使用してください。

        - [プラグイン](/jp/cli/configuration/plugins.html): プラグインを使用すると、プロジェクトやチーム間で共有できるカスタム機能でDroidを拡張できます。プラグインは、スキル、スラッシュコマンド、エージェント、MCPサーバーを
        - [サンドボックス](/jp/cli/configuration/sandbox.html): <Aside kind="note"> **Beta** — OS レベルのサンドボックスはオプトインであり、活発に開発が進められています。動作、設定、 プラットフォームサポートはリリースごとに変更される

  - [Plans & Pricing](/pricing.html): Factory plans use rolling Rate Limits across three windows: 5-hour, weekly, and monthly. Your plan's Standard Usage gives you access to all models and is consumed first. Business and Enterprise plans are not affected by Rate Limit changes.
